articleTitle: Should You Take Pre-Workout for Early Morning Classes?
imageHeadline: Pre-Workout Before Your 6 AM Class: What to Know

pinTitle: Should You Take Pre-Workout for Early Morning Workouts? What Research Says
pinDescription: If you exercise early, pre-workout can help—but timing and caffeine content matter more than you think. Learn what the evidence says about morning pre-workout use, how to avoid jitters or crashes, and what actually supports performance when you're training before sunrise.
